sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG M1 DyLight594 staining on live HEK293 cells; receptor used in β-arrestin recruitment and trafficking assays, implying preserved function.
sites.rationale: C5AR1 has no signal peptide (raw topology begins with 'O', extracellular from residue 1); the sole extracellular terminus is the N-terminus, so an N-terminal FLAG tag must prepend before M1 (insert_after_residue=0). Python confirms seq[0]='M'. The 34-residue N-terminal extracellular domain separates the tag from TM1 (residue 35), far exceeding the 3-residue minimum. L1 and L2 directly confirm surface display; L3 confirms functional use of the same construct. Full-length C5aR1 expressed in HEK293 cells with an N-terminal FLAG tag in pcDNA3.1; stable cell lines generated and surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG M1 antibody staining (requires CaCl2, confirming the tag is extracellular). The same FLAG–C5aR1 construct was used in functional and trafficking studies (β-arrestin recruitment, receptor internalization). No signal peptide is present (topology residues 1–34 are extracellular from residue 1), so the tag prepends before M1.

sources.claim: Stable cell lines expressing N-terminal Flag tagged receptor constructs in pcDNA3.1 vector were generated by transfecting HEK293 cells with 7 μg of plasmid DNA using polyethylenimine (PEI) (Polysciences, Cat. no. 19850), followed by selection using G418 (GIBCO, Cat. no. 11811-031, 200-1000 μg ml -1 ).

literature_notes: L4 (PMC9937529) describes an N-terminal FLAG tag preceded by an artificial HA signal sequence for insect-cell expression of a truncated construct (residues 1–330). This corroborates the N-terminal prepend site but is subsumed by the stronger mammalian-cell evidence of L1/L2/L3 and is not listed as a separate site because it maps to the same junction (insert_after_residue=0). No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion (ECL1, ECL2, ECL3) for C5AR1. L5/L6 and L7 report C-terminal tags; the C-terminus (residues 305–350) is intracellular per the topology landmarks and is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused to the C-terminus of C5aR1 for vesicle-based deep mutagenesis; C-terminus is intracellular (topology residues 305–350), confirmed by ELISA on vesicles targeting the GFP tag.
Nine-amino-acid bovine rhodopsin COOH-terminal tag appended to C5aR expressed in HEK293T cells; C-terminus is intracellular (topology residues 305–350).
